description: Create the Porkbun DNS zone for a domain whose inbound transfer is held, so records can be added before the domain moves. Step 2 of the no-downtime sequence (transfer_domain with hold_for_dns_setup, prepare_transfer, import_dns_records, start_transfer). Returns the Porkbun nameservers. The zone is created deliberately, not as a side effect of the first record write, which is why this call exists.

domain.description: Domain with a held inbound transfer.

name: prepare_transfer
title: Prepare Transfer
